ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell Profile Modification
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation or modification of a powershell profile which could indicate suspicious activity as the profile can be used as a mean of persistence

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX("\\\\Microsoft\\\.PowerShell\\_profile\\\.ps1$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\\PowerShell\\\\profile\\\.ps1$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\PowerShell\\\\7\\-preview\\\\profile\\\.ps1$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\PowerShell\\\\7\\\\profile\\\.ps1$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\profile\\\.ps1$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\profile\\\.ps1$"))
